summary: Project content is signed with the ansible-sign CLI using GPG (the only supported method) and verified by controller; an invalid signature or changed file fails the project update and blocks jobs. To change a signed project, edit, run ansible-sign project gpg-sign and commit the manifest and signature.
questions: How do I sign my Ansible project?
What happens if a signed project file changes?
What signing methods does ansible-sign support?
